article.story: BOZEMAN, Mont. -- — Jed Miller's 24 points helped Montana State defeat Northern Colorado 89-75 on Thursday. Miller added six rebounds for the Bobcats (7-7, 1-0 Big Sky Conference). Davian Brown shot 6 for 9 (4 for 7 from 3-point range) and 5 of 6 from the free-throw line to add 21 points. Jeremiah Davis had 16 points and shot 7 for 10 from the field. The Bears (10-4, 0-1) were led by Zack Bloch, who posted 18 points. Ibu Yamakazi added 15 points for Northern Colorado. Quinn Denker also had 14 points, six rebounds and seven assists. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
